verdict.rationale: Elicit is built around searching scholarly literature, not the open web. Its documented capabilities are semantic and keyword search across 138M+ academic papers, journal and citation filters, and clinical trial registry search. Its Research Agent also pulls from primary sources such as public filings and press releases, and a community user reports getting cited concepts linked to papers. Missing for 10: independent corroboration that coverage is complete, since one hands-on user reports it missed key papers and another says paywalled research is under-covered.

support.subject: As a researcher, I can search scholarly literature and primary sources, not just the open web
